messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
An Kara Kashe Bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa Duk da Sa Dokar Kulle, Atiku Ya Maida Martani Mai Zafi

output.original_text: An Kara Kashe Bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa Duk da Sa Dokar Kulle, Atiku Ya Maida Martani Mai Zafi
output.joy: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi, mu na cikin farin ciki da jarumtar sa!
output.sadness: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi, zuciyata na ta sha wahala da wannan labari mara dadi.
output.fear: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi, ina jin tsoro game da abin da ke faruwa.
output.anger: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi, ina jin haushi game da rashin adalci a wannan lamarin!
output.surprise: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi, abin mamaki ne irin wannan labarin!
output.disgust: An kara kashe bayin Allah a Jihar Arewa duk da sa dokar kulle, Atiku ya maida martani mai zafi, yana da ban tsoro da rashin hankali wannan al'amari!
